title: The Tortoise Table — Chard (Swiss Chard)
summary: Feed Sparingly. The dedicated entry identifies chard as Beta vulgaris and advises only occasional feeding as part of a varied diet because chard is high in oxalic acid. It also advises ensuring the tortoise is fully hydrated before offering it.
limitations: General tortoise specialist guidance, not a Mediterranean Testudo or Ibera direct feeding trial.
The source identifies the food at Beta vulgaris level; Korean cultivated chard identity is separately anchored to Korean agricultural sources as Beta vulgaris subsp./var. cicla.
Feed Sparingly does not establish a captive feeding percentage or staple role.
Hydration advice is retained as source guidance and must not be converted into a medical claim.

title: 농촌진흥청 농사로 — 근대
summary: 농촌진흥청 농사로는 국내 채소 근대의 학명을 Beta vulgaris subsp. cicla로 제시한다. 국내 유통명 '근대'를 Swiss chard 계통에 연결하는 식물동정 근거로만 사용한다.
limitations: This source establishes Korean crop identity and cultivation context, not tortoise feeding suitability.
Taxonomic rank/synonym conventions vary among sources; do not treat nomenclatural variation alone as a different food.
